The petitioner herein seeks a declaration to declare that the land acquisition proceedings of the first respondent in G.O. Ms. No.466, Revenue Department, dated 05.06.1998 and the proceedings of the third respondent in Na.Ka.No.10654/2009(A7) dated 22.02.2010 are invalid and void in so far as it relates to lands comprised in Patta No.2616 in Survey No.325/1A, measuring an extent of 1-11.0 Hectares situated at Siluvampatty Village, Namakkal Taluk & District, belonged to the petitioner herein as the said notification issued under Sec.4 (1) of the land Acquisition Act, 1894, got https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis lapsed and inoperative both under the provisions the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and in view of the enactment of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 2. By consent of both the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as respondents, this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage itself.
3. It is the case of the petitioner that the notification under Section 4 (1) of old Act was issued on 05.06.1998.
It is contended by the petitioner that the declaration under Section 6 of the Act has not been made.
Therefore, the acquisition proceedings got lapsed even under the provisions of the old Act.
Thus, the petitioner seeks a declaration as prayed for in this writ petition.

4. Mr. Arasakumar, learned Government Advocate, who takes notice for the respondents has produced a written instruction dated 11.09.2024 in ROC.No.1745/2024/A4 from Tahsildar,
Namakkal, stating that the notification issued under Section 4 (1) the old Act dated 05.06.1998 was lapsed on 31.12.2009 and formal orders from government for dropping land acquisition https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis proceedings in respect of petitioner's land in S.No.325/1A is awaited.
The said statement of the learned Government Advocate is recorded.

5. The notification under Section 4 (1) of the old Act was issued on 05.06.1998 and thereafter,
further proceedings under the Act has not been taken.

Admittedly, the declaration under Section 6 of the Act has not been made within time stipulated by statute and therefore, the entire acquisition K.Vangili vs The State Of Tamilnadu on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199318241/
